title: The 6 best AI resume builders in 2026
summary: We spent time testing every resume builder we could get our hands on, and these are our picks for the best AI resume builders to help you land a job.

Pipeline for tracking application process for multiple openings


Free plan available with limited AI usage; paid plans start at $13/week


****Resume.io


Job matching and distributing your CV

Free plan available for 1 CV and 1 cover letter; 7-day trial priced at $2.95, upgrading to $24.95 every 4 weeks


Kickresume


Generating a resume from scratch


AI tools for generating and optimizing resumes; interview question practice


Free plan available without AI features; from $8/month (billed annually) or $24/month (billed monthly)


Resume Worded


Leveraging your LinkedIn profile


Scoring and breakdown of LinkedIn profile; adaptation to job openings


Limited free plan; from $19/month (billed annually), $33/month (billed quarterly), or $49/month (billed monthly)


ResumeNerd


Adapting your resume as you browse jobs


Job feed with matching score; shortcuts to add skills from job descriptions


From $2.75 for 2 weeks; price increases after initial period
